source: BootROMs/dmg_boot.asm (with sameboot.inc and hardware.inc) at c458e7c5d2d350fb37a1931c40da9f758d28d240, unchanged since 77b7f861f3; RGBDS v1.0.4 builds the same bytes from it
success: From power-on the boot ROM unmaps itself with FF50 at 00FE and the CPU reaches 0100 within maxTCycles with AF 01B0, BC 0013, DE 00D8, HL 014D, SP FFFE; LCDC 91, BGP FC, SCY 00, NR50 77, NR51 F3, NR52 F1; FF50 reads FF and 0000-00FF read the cartridge; LY 144 in mode 1 (just after the VBlank flag of its last frame wait); tiles 1-24 hold the header logo (0104-0133) with every bit doubled, tile 25 the (R), and the map 9904-990F = 01-0C, 9910 = 19, 9924-992F = 0D-18 with the rest of 9800-9BFF zero. Mooneye boot_regs-dmgABC then passes (the boot ROM sets the DMG registers).
